extra_setup: 4 Sparks cabled as a switchless dual-rail RoCE ring; run scripts/fabric-setup.sh (MTU 9000, routes, DOCKER-USER forwarding) after every reboot/docker churn; user must build/provide patched NCCL 2.30.7 (skip-tree-connect) at $HOME/nccl-patched/libnccl.so.2 on each node, mounted at /opt/patched-nccl; download weights to $HOME/glm53-flash-nvfp4 and drafter incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2 to $HOME/glm53-dflash2-draft; cache dir $HOME/glm53-tp4-cache -> /cache. Launch ranks 3,2,1 then 0.
notes: ${TAIL} = '--host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000' on rank 0, '--headless' on ranks 1-3. MASTER=head mgmt IP (example 10.0.0.1), MPORT=29520, MGMT_IF default enP7s7, IB_HCA default rocep1s0f0,rocep1s0f1, MIP = this node's mgmt IP. Image default entrypoint (vllm serve) used. bf16 KV pool capped at 12 GiB (higher risks OOM hard-hang). Model rated 1M ctx; 262K served. GitHub license API reports NOASSERTION but LICENSE file is MIT (Alex Ellis, OpenFaaS Ltd). First collective can deadlock; relaunch all four.
